00163 void ScopeGUI::setAudioBuffer(Buffer const& audioBufferToUse, const double offset, const int fftSizeOfSource) throw()
00164 {   
00165     offsetSamples = offset; // this will be a time offset in samples or the first bin for an FFT
00166     
00167     if(fftSizeOfSource > 0)
00168         fftSize = fftSizeOfSource;
00169     
00170     if(tryLock() == true)
00171     {
00172         if((smoothingBuffer.size() > 0) && 
00173            (audioBuffer.size() == audioBufferToUse.size()) &&
00174            (audioBuffer.getNumChannels() == audioBufferToUse.getNumChannels())
00175         ) {
00176             // smoothingBuffer should be interpolation coeffs for each channel
00177             // so Buffer(0.25, 1.0) should smooth even channels but not odd channels
00178             
00180             
00181             Buffer newBuffer;
00182             
00183             for(int i = 0; i < audioBuffer.getNumChannels(); i++)
00184             {
00185                 const float coeff = smoothingBuffer.wrapAt(i);
00186                 
00187                 if(coeff <= 0.0 || coeff >= 1.0)
00188                     newBuffer <<= audioBufferToUse.getChannel(i);
00189                 else
00190                     newBuffer <<= audioBufferToUse.getChannel(i) * coeff + audioBuffer.getChannel(i) * (1.f-coeff);
00191             }
00192             
00193             audioBuffer = newBuffer;
00194         }
00195         else
00196             audioBuffer = audioBufferToUse.copy();
00197         
00198         initBuffers();
00199         unlock();
00200         
00201         updateGUI();
00202     }
00203 }

00318 void ScopeGUI::calculateBuffers()
00319 {   
00320     if(tryLock() == true)
00321     {
00322         const int audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
00323         const int drawBufferSize = getWidth();
00324         
00325         if(audioBufferSize > 0 && minDrawBuffer.size() > 0 && maxDrawBuffer.size() > 0)
00326         {
00327             minDrawBuffer.clear();
00328             maxDrawBuffer.clear();
00329             
00330             const double drawIndexInc = min(1.0, (double)drawBufferSize / (double)audioBufferSize);
00331             const double audioIndexInc = min(1.0, (double)audioBufferSize / (double)drawBufferSize);
00332             
00333             for(int channel = 0; channel < audioBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00334             {       
00335                 if(drawIndexInc < 1.0)
00336                 {
00337                     double drawIndex = 0.0;         
00338                     int previousDrawIndex = -1;
00339                     float minimum, maximum;
00340                     
00341                     for(int sample = 0; sample < audioBufferSize; sample++, drawIndex += drawIndexInc)
00342                     {
00343                         const int iDrawIndex = (int)drawIndex;
00344                         float value = audioBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, sample);
00345                         if(previousDrawIndex != iDrawIndex)
00346                         {
00347                             if(previousDrawIndex >= 0)
00348                             {
00349                                 minDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, previousDrawIndex, minimum);
00350                                 maxDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, previousDrawIndex, maximum);
00351                             }
00352                             
00353                             minimum = maximum = value;
00354                             previousDrawIndex = iDrawIndex;
00355                         }
00356                         else
00357                         {
00358                             minimum = min(minimum, value);
00359                             maximum = max(maximum, value);
00360                         }
00361                     }
00362                 }
00363                 else
00364                 {
00365                     double audioIndex = 0.0;
00366                     
00367                     for(int horiz = 0; horiz < drawBufferSize; horiz++, audioIndex += audioIndexInc)
00368                     {
00369                         float value = audioBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, (int)audioIndex);
00370                         minDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, horiz, value);
00371                         maxDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, horiz, value);
00372                     }
00373                 }
00374                 
00375             }
00376         }
00377         
00378         unlock();
00379     }
00380 }

00392 ScopeUGenInternal::ScopeUGenInternal(ScopeGUI* scopeGUI, UGen const& input, UGen const& duration) throw()
00393 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00394     scopeGUI_(scopeGUI),
00395     audioBuffer(BufferSpec((int)(UGen::getSampleRate()), input.getNumChannels(), true)),
00396     bufferIndex(0),
00397     audioBufferSizeUsed(0),
00398     samplesProcessed(0)
00399 {
00400     inputs[Input] = input;
00401     inputs[Duration] = duration;
00402 }
00403 
00404 void ScopeUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00405 {
00406     if(scopeGUI_->isValid())
00407     {
00408         float duration = *(inputs[Duration].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0));
00409         int audioBufferSizeRequired = max(1, (int)(duration * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00410         int audioBufferAllocatedSize = audioBuffer.size();            
00411         
00412         if(audioBufferSizeRequired > audioBufferAllocatedSize)
00413         {
00414             if((audioBufferAllocatedSize > 1) && (bufferIndex >= audioBufferAllocatedSize))
00415             {
00416                 scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferAllocatedSize-1), 
00417                                           samplesProcessed);
00418                 samplesProcessed += audioBufferAllocatedSize;
00419             }
00420             
00421             audioBuffer = Buffer(audioBufferSizeRequired, inputs[Input].getNumChannels(), false);
00422             audioBufferSizeUsed = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00423             bufferIndex = 0;
00424         }
00425         else if(audioBufferSizeRequired < audioBufferAllocatedSize)
00426         {
00427             audioBufferSizeUsed = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00428             
00429             if(bufferIndex >= audioBufferSizeUsed)
00430             {
00431                 scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferSizeUsed-1),
00432                                           samplesProcessed);
00433                 samplesProcessed += audioBufferSizeUsed;
00434                 bufferIndex = 0;
00435             }
00436         }
00437         
00438         int channelBufferIndex;
00439         
00440         for(int channel = 0; channel < audioBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00441         {
00442             int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00443             float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00444             float* bufferSamples = audioBuffer.getData(channel);
00445             channelBufferIndex = bufferIndex; // need a copy of this so it's the same at the start of processing each channel
00446             
00447             int bufferSamplesToProcess = audioBufferSizeUsed - channelBufferIndex;
00448             
00449             if(bufferSamplesToProcess > numSamplesToProcess)
00450             {               
00451                 while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00452                     bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00453             }
00454             else
00455             {
00456                 while(bufferSamplesToProcess--)
00457                     bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00458                 
00459                 channelBufferIndex = 0;
00460             }
00461         }
00462         
00463         bufferIndex = channelBufferIndex; // store for next block
00464         
00465         if(bufferIndex == 0)
00466         {
00467             scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferSizeUsed-1),
00468                                       samplesProcessed);
00469             samplesProcessed += audioBufferSizeUsed;
00470         }
00471     }
00472 }

00480 SpectralScopeUGenInternal::SpectralScopeUGenInternal(ScopeGUI* scopeGUI, 
00481                                                      UGen const& input, 
00482                                                      ScopeGUI::ScopeModes mode,
00483                                                      FFTEngine const& fft, 
00484                                                      const int overlap,
00485                                                      const int firstBin,
00486                                                      const int numBins) throw()
00487 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),    
00488     scopeGUI_(scopeGUI),
00489     mode_(mode),
00490     fftEngine(fft),
00491     fftSize(fftEngine.size()),
00492     fftSizeHalved(fftSize / 2),
00493     overlap_(overlap < 1 ? 1 : overlap),
00494     firstBin_(firstBin < fftSizeHalved ? firstBin : fftSizeHalved),
00495     maxNumBins(fftSizeHalved - firstBin_ + 1),
00496     numBins_(numBins ? (numBins < maxNumBins ? numBins : maxNumBins) : maxNumBins),
00497     inputBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize, input.getNumChannels(), true)),
00498     outputBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize, input.getNumChannels(), true)),
00499     bufferIndex(0)
00500 {
00501     inputs[Input] = input;  
00502 }

00509 void SpectralScopeUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00510 {
00511     if(scopeGUI_->isValid())
00512     {
00513         int channelBufferIndex;
00514         
00515         // keep filling the buffer until it has enough samples...
00516         for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00517         {
00518             int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00519             float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00520             float* bufferSamples = inputBuffer.getData(channel);
00521             channelBufferIndex = bufferIndex; // need a copy of this so it's the same at the start of processing each channel
00522             
00523             int bufferSamplesToProcess = fftSize - channelBufferIndex;
00524             
00525             if(bufferSamplesToProcess > numSamplesToProcess)
00526             {               
00527                 while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00528                     bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00529             }
00530             else
00531             {
00532                 while(bufferSamplesToProcess--)
00533                     bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00534                 
00535                 channelBufferIndex = 0;
00536             }
00537         }
00538         
00539         bufferIndex = channelBufferIndex; // store for next block
00540         
00541         // was the buffer filled ?
00542         if(bufferIndex == 0)
00543         {
00544             // do fft and send
00545             for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00546             {               
00547                 fftEngine.fft(outputBuffer, inputBuffer, true, channel, channel);
00548             }
00549                         
00550             switch(mode_)
00551             {
00552                 case ScopeGUI::RealImagRaw:
00553                     scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(outputBuffer, 
00554                                               0, 
00555                                               fftSize);
00556                     break;
00557                 case ScopeGUI::RealImagRawSplit:
00558                     scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagRawSplit(outputBuffer),
00559                                               0,
00560                                               fftSize);
00561                     break;
00562                 case ScopeGUI::RealImagUnpacked:
00563                     scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagUnpacked(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00564                                               firstBin_,
00565                                               fftSize);
00566                     break;
00567                 case ScopeGUI::RealImagUnpackedSplit:
00568                     scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagUnpackedSplit(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00569                                               firstBin_,
00570                                               fftSize);
00571                     break;
00572                 case ScopeGUI::MagnitudePhase:
00573                     scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitudePhase(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00574                                               firstBin_,
00575                                               fftSize);
00576                     break;
00577                 case ScopeGUI::MagnitudePhaseSplit:
00578                     scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitudePhaseSplit(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00579                                               firstBin_,
00580                                               fftSize);
00581                     break;                  
00582                 case ScopeGUI::Magnitude: 
00583                     scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitude(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00584                                               firstBin_,
00585                                               fftSize);
00586                     break;
00587                 case ScopeGUI::Phase: 
00588                     scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToPhase(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00589                                               firstBin_,
00590                                               fftSize);
00591                     break;
00592                 default:
00593                     scopeGUI_->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitude(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00594                                               firstBin_,
00595                                               fftSize);
00596             }
00597             
00598             // keep overlapping samples for next FFT
00599             if((overlap_ > 1) && (uGenOutput.getBlockSize() < fftSize))
00600             {
00601                 const int hopSize = fftSize / overlap_;
00602                 const int copySize = fftSize - hopSize;
00603                 
00604                 for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00605                 {
00606                     float *bufferSamples = inputBuffer.getData(channel);
00607                     memcpy(bufferSamples, bufferSamples + hopSize, copySize * sizeof(float));
00608                 }
00609                 
00610                 bufferIndex = copySize;
00611             }
00612         }
00613     }
00614 }
